name: firebase-ai-starter-kit
description: Production-minded Firebase + Gemini AI starter kit: Auth, Firestore, secure Cloud Functions, reusable AI integrations.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/web run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions run test:unit && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-fb-ai-starter-kit "npm --prefix functions run test:rules"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:rules
scripts.verify: npm run check:secrets && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
